provenance.description: User-supplied two-MIDI-track Set for bar-by-bar monitoring, 120 BPM, 1-bar global quantization, saved stopped at beat 0. Track 0 operator (Operator): Arrangement clip-1 beats 0-96 then clip-2 beats 96-128, so its pattern changes at song bar 25. Track 1 drums (808 Core Kit): Session scene 2 long-clip-listen is 32 bars with the pattern changing at clip bar 17; its Arrangement also changes at bar 17. Both tracks carry a Machine-Listening listener at device index 1. Original saved bytes retained; Core Library instruments and samples are installed prerequisites, not redistributed.
